thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM side on last week's postmortem — we need explicit owners + target dates for the canary/flag improvements (auto-rollback, blast-radius defaults, metric gates). Please reply with short commitments so I can close the action list.

raj: I can own auto-rollback code + rollout. Plan: implement graceful rollback hook, add unit + integration tests, then canary rollout. Targeting end of next week (2025-04-04). Will open INF-2345 today.

ashley: I'll take blast-radius defaults and flag controls. Proposal: default 0.5% initial, 5% after 24h, with a hard max of 20% unless explicitly approved. I'll draft a short RFC and a UI change for the flag page. ETA: 2025-03-31. Ticket INF-2350.

oliver: Agree on metric gates. I'll add CPU and 5xx error-rate gates to the rollout controller. Also adding a configurable "pause on regressions" threshold so the rollout pauses before exceeding blast radius. ETA: 3 business days. Ticket INF-2351.

sre-oncall: I'll own the synthetic canary job and the acceptance test harness. We'll run a lightweight load + healthcheck against the canary pool every 10m and post results to #incidents. Putting a tracking ticket INF-2352; expect infra ready by 2025-03-28.

deploy-bot: deploy-checker: noted owners -> INF-2345 (raj), INF-2350 (ashley), INF-2351 (oliver), INF-2352 (sre-oncall). Canary policy defaults pending manual review.

maria: Thanks. Two asks: 1) put the single-line owner/due in the ticket summary, 2) add a one-paragraph runbook update mentioning rollback signals and who hits the button.

raj: Will add summary + runbook snippet to INF-2345. Runbook snippet I'll add to the "rollouts" page under docs.

ashley: RFC link when ready — will include migration plan for existing flags and an opt-in for orgs that want wider default exposure.

oliver: Quick question for @sre-oncall — do we want the synthetic canary to fail the rollout automatically or just alert?

sre-oncall: Prefer alerts first, then auto-pause for repeat failures within a window. Auto-abort only if multiple independent signals (metric gates + canary job) fail. We can iterate.

product-ops: From product POV, let's keep the initial default tight. Customers hate regressions > 1%. Happy to approve 0.5% -> 5% ramp.

maria: Putting the consolidated checklist here so we can mark closure. Please update ticket numbers if I got anything wrong.

```
- [ ] Auto-rollback implementation — owner: raj — JIRA: INF-2345 — due: 2025-04-04
- [ ] Blast-radius & flag UX defaults — owner: ashley — JIRA: INF-2350 — due: 2025-03-31
- [ ] Metric gates + pause logic — owner: oliver — JIRA: INF-2351 — due: 2025-03-28
- [ ] Synthetic canary + acceptance harness — owner: sre-oncall — JIRA: INF-2352 — due: 2025-03-28
- [ ] Runbook + docs update — owner: maria — JIRA: INF-2353 — due: 2025-04-07
```

raj: I'll mark INF-2345 WIP and post a short PR checklist when code is ready.

ashley: RFC by EOD tomorrow.

oliver: I'll start the metrics PR today and ping eng-sre for thresholds.

sre-oncall: I'll create INF-2352 and add the synthetic job job definition to the infra repo.

maria: Great. Let's do a quick sync in 48h to confirm progress and unblock any blockers. If anyone hits delays, ping me and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:

product-ops: Adding a note to the customer-facing rollout guidance so support has the right expectations.

maria: Thanks all — closing this thread and will export to the postmortem action tracker once each ticket has the owner/due. :white_check_mark:
